text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Thanks for giving 
me some time off!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I relaxed in my room listening to my 
favorite idol's songs, and it was so 
healing~"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling fully refreshed, so let's give 
it our all again today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon thoroughly enjoyed her day 
off and seemed fully refreshed.
